ui_bugs.issue: After auto-import the Source filter chip stays on 'All' instead of switching to 'AIM'. setFSource('AIM') is dispatched but then `load()` is called in the SAME effect using the stale closure of fSource='all'. The next useFocusEffect-driven load may re-render correctly but the chip UI shows 'All' as active. Cosmetic — items still render because they're newest. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/action-center.tsx:104-105 (setFSource('AIM'); load();)

action_items: Minor UX polish: in /app/frontend/app/tools/action-center.tsx after `setFSource('AIM')` either skip the immediate load() (let the load-effect re-fire when fSource changes via useFocusEffect/useCallback dep), or call load with a one-off override (e.g. load({source: 'AIM'})). Currently the items still appear because they sort newest-first, but the highlighted chip is wrong.
